description: Paired MVS / MVPS view subsets of the published objects, in published view names. MVS: k-means on the MVS camera centres (scikit-learn KMeans, random_state=42, n_init=10), camera nearest to each centroid; MVPS: pose nearest to each selected MVS view, without duplicate (scipy linear_sum_assignment). distance_mm: distance between the paired camera centres. Written by martine-convert subsets --regenerate.
